name: internship-tracker
description: Development-only dependencies: Playwright for the browser tests. The app itself needs no Node packages.

scripts.test: node --test tests/core.test.js tests/regressions.test.js tests/fixtures.test.js && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
scripts.demo: python3 scripts/make_demo_data.py demo-data && IAT_AI_STUB=1 python3 server.py --data demo-data --no-fetch --port 8766
